description: This file defines the SyncEngine class responsible for orchestrating synchronization of notes between local storage and a remote API. It manages connectivity monitoring, retry logic with exponential backoff, and ensures data consistency during push and pull operations in a note-taking app.

classes.name: SyncEngine
classes.description: A class responsible for synchronizing notes between local storage and remote server, handling connectivity, retries, and data reconciliation.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes the sync process by observing network connectivity and triggering sync when the device goes online.

methods.name: syncOnce
methods.description: Performs a single synchronization attempt, pushing local changes to the remote and pulling updates.

methods.name: triggerSync
methods.description: Starts a sync task if none is already in progress.

methods.name: scheduleRetryWithBackoff
methods.description: Schedules a retry of the sync operation using exponential backoff delay, respecting network connectivity.

methods.name: performSyncAttempt
methods.description: Performs the actual push and pull operations with error handling, retry logic, and backoff management.

methods.name: markCurrentDirtyBatchAsFailedBestEffort
methods.description: Marks all currently dirty notes as failed to enable retries.
